about: Readme marker comments: an HTML comment whose text starts with a marker word (mojo-hidden or any <lang>-hidden, include, not-tested) renders nothing, and the fence after it renders whole. A comment with no marker word renders as every other comment does (nothing). A marker word inside code, or in a <!-- that is not a comment, stays text. Written here from the rule in komira's docs/design/documentation_tests.md in komira-ai/komira ("Include, fill and freshness", "Decisions to take"); to be replaced by the vector file komira publishes for the same rule. Each vector: name; markdown, a readme; marker, the marker word its comment starts with, or null when the readme holds no marker comment (a comment with no marker word, or a marker word that is not in a comment); html, what the readme renderer emits for it.
